posts.title: James Webb telescope is changing our understanding of the beginning of time
posts.description: The James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) has found numerous early galaxies and black holes that are too big and complex for their age. Cosmologists are rethinking many long standing models of the early universe. JWST is proving to be a monumental success and a testament to public funding for science and exploration.

posts.title: SpaceX catches the Starship booster!
posts.description: SpaceX achieved another historic milestone today with Starship’s 5th test flight by returning the massive booster back to the launch site and catching it in the arms of their launch tower “mechazilla.” This is an astounding achievement, and they nailed it on the first attempt.
